components.name: TMX
components.purpose: Supply market observations for explicit source contracts.
components.inputs: Symbol, interval and bounded history requests.
components.outputs: Bars, quotes and source responses.

components.boundaries: Successful requests do not prove timely, complete or venue-qualified minute coverage. Hermes daily requests remain separate.

components.name: Wealthsimple
components.summary: Broker accounts, executable quotes and orders
components.purpose: Provide actual account observations and broker order outcomes.
components.inputs: Authenticated reads and explicitly authorized order requests.
components.outputs: Cash, holdings, quotes, order observations and fills.
components.responsibilities: Broker-side account and order service.
components.boundaries: Only the trading engine owns the broker execution path. An acknowledgement is not a fill; a fresh bid cannot repair stale indicator history.

components.name: Language-model provider

components.inputs: Dossiers or scoped review packets and call budgets.

components.responsibilities: External model inference.

components.name: TraderVI.Collector
components.purpose: Keep shared observations available independently of the trading process.
components.inputs: Candidate, benchmark, held-symbol and pending-exit subscriptions; TMX responses.
components.outputs: Immutable minute receipts in SQL and original legacy responses over the local relay.
components.responsibilities: Own shared intraday requests, bounded backfill, gap/conflict capture and subscription union.
components.boundaries: No broker credentials, order adapter or financial activation. Trader restart does not stop collection; collector survival does not keep protection running when the engine is stopped.

components.name: Collector supervision
components.purpose: Maintain one collector owner and reject writes from a former owner.
components.inputs: Process lifecycle and database-clock lease generation.
components.outputs: Bounded restart supervision and fenced ownership.
components.responsibilities: Keep collector lifetime independent of WPF and trader; prevent stale writers committing.
components.boundaries: Installed supervision is for the current login at the cited checkpoint. Reboot/login startup is not installed; broader native recovery acceptance remains.
components.evidence: Dated checkpoint: 2026-10-28 13:45 Toronto, from Docs/project-status.md. Not live status.

components.name: Legacy request relay
components.purpose: Deliver legacy intraday observations through the collector.
components.inputs: Same-user local requests under the frozen legacy source contract.
components.outputs: Original responses with original request and receipt times.
components.responsibilities: Route shared requests without a trading-process market HTTP fallback.
components.boundaries: Never substitute minute aggregates for legacy observations. Consumer still owns publication, audit and Paper lifecycle.
components.evidence: Dated checkpoint: 2026-10-28 13:45 Toronto, from Docs/project-status.md. Not live status.

components.name: SQL Server / TraderDB
components.purpose: Store shared market evidence and independently owned financial/research histories.
components.inputs: Collector receipts, daily publications, account events and revisions.
components.outputs: Coherent local reads, durable records and audit evidence.
components.responsibilities: Preserve identities, first arrivals, failures, gaps, conflicts and transaction boundaries.
components.boundaries: One physical database does not merge Paper and Real ownership. Backfill does not rewrite original arrival times. Schema changes require reviewed manual migrations.

components.name: TraderVI.Engine
components.purpose: Run trading and protection independently of dashboard lifetime and optional research backlog.
components.inputs: Collector relay/local evidence, selected daily inputs and each account's own state.
components.outputs: Shared published inputs, independent account decisions, audits and execution work.
components.responsibilities: Own Real evaluation, Paper schedules, broker reconciliation, executable quotes and protection.
components.boundaries: Closing WPF leaves the host running. Stopping the engine stops its automatic protection. Real does not wait for Paper or import its confirmation/fills.
